title: David J NDE 4050
content: I found myself in a dark void. The next thing I noticed was that there was no sense of anything; it was like I was just a naked mind. I missed the feel and sound of a heartbeat, and the familiar feel and sound of a regular breath. There was nothing. There were no sensations at all. That's when someone called out to me. It was not a sound, it was like a sound but it was more as if I felt it in my mind just like it bypassed my ears and went straight to my brain. He sounded very much like I should know him. What he said was most unusual. I realized I had just died. That is a traumatic occasion. I find myself with no sensation in a black void, and someone calls out to me. How did I know it was to me? I don't know, but I knew it was to me. He said, 'Are you back, already?' That was when I saw the light. It was a bright, round, blue white some distance away. It felt right, to me, that he was there, in the light. I wanted to see whom it was that had called out to me, and it seemed because I wanted to see who was there. The light started to look like it was closer. I have no idea if I moved to the light or the light moved toward me, all I know is the light got larger until I was in it. Descriptions of what I saw and heard are very difficult, because we haven't invented the words. We have not invented the words because this is outside our experience. My best attempt at a description would be it looked as if it was somewhere in space. But when I saw my friend with his friends, now that was never in any picture I have ever seen. He appeared to me as a blue-white sphere of light, and he was with a group of other spheres. Their color of light ranged from a bright slightly pinkish color to my friend's blue-white light. I spoke, before I thought if I could. I asked him, 'Are YOU GOD?' He laughed for a while, and he had a very good laugh, it made you feel the humor, it made you feel happy inside, it made you smile. He was a long way away. Long as across a galaxy, or whatever looked like a galaxy. It did look like pictures I have since seen taken from the Hubble telescope. Distance seemed to have little effect on our communication. I could see and hear him as if he were next to me. When he stopped laughing he said to me,' No, I am Not, and they don't like to be called that. They are the shepherd. They are the shepherd because that is what they do, they guide and protect.' My friend and I talked for a while. He told me some things, he showed me some others, but all too soon, I was back in the dark void. This time it was different because there was someone there with me. This is very difficult to describe, and I know I will never, nor can ever describe what I felt from this entity, or this person, or this whatever this was. I felt power, immense power. I did not know power had a feeling, but this felt like all the power anyone could imagine times a billion. But there was not just a feeling of power there was an equal feeling of love. Let there be no questions. Anyone would do anything; happily do anything for this entity, whatever it is. The feeling of power and love was so strong it almost seemed solid. I could not see who it was or what they looked like. It was like my sight was blocked. I was just stunned. It was a while before I noticed there were others there. These others I could see and talk to. Judgment seems too harsh a word I would like more to call it an evaluation of my life and me. The others did that. They would be there throughout my life, and it did seem to me that I did live my life, again. I never thought that what you think and feel is more important than what you say and do. Each of the others would stop my life and show me when some important event happened, then they reported that to that powerful, dark, loving Presence. Respect you feel for others, forgiveness of others and others of you, moments of realizations of what others do for you, first love and all feelings involved, moments of personal growth and development these are what I was evaluated on, but then, I was only twelve. I did not see or hear anything from that presence until the evaluation was over and the others grew still and quiet. Then he spoke, he spoke to me. This is what he said, 'You may not pass on from this. You must go back and live out your life. You must live your life for three reasons. The first is that you are meant to do something that you have not, yet, done. The second is you are meant to influence someone you have not, yet, met. The third is you have not learned enough, yet to accomplish the other two.' That was it. With his last words, I felt myself fading out as I assumed I was in a transition back to my life, but as this was happening, he said one last thing to me. He said, 'Tell no one of what you have learned here in this place on this day. It is not, yet time,' I was back in my body. My hands flew away from the pipe and I fell down, but I didn't care at the time. Forty-two years later, I felt that presence again. I will never forget that feeling. This time he said, 'Now is the time to tell your story, tell your story now.' There has been a third time I have encountered that presence. Each time my sight was blocked, so I have no idea who it is.

arrival.other_being_detail: A familiar-sounding 'friend' appeared as a blue-white sphere of light with other spheres; later a powerful, dark, loving Presence was sensed but not seen ('my sight was blocked').

environment.environment_other_detail: Initially a 'dark void' with no sensations; later a bright round blue-white light 'somewhere in space' with distances like 'across a galaxy' (compared to Hubble images).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told three reasons: meant to do something not yet done; meant to influence someone not yet met; had not learned enough yet to accomplish the other two.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt himself 'fading out' in transition back, then 'was back in my body.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Must go back and live out life for three stated reasons (unfinished task, influence someone not yet met, insufficient learning yet). Also later instructed: 'Now is the time to tell your story, tell your story now.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial dark void with no sensations; spheres of light identified as 'shepherd' guides; later powerful dark loving Presence not visually seen; instruction to keep silent until later, then later told to share story.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Void first, then voice/communication, then distant light expanding until within it; later returned to void for evaluation/life review; then told to return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the dark void after time with the light/spheres, then proceeded to evaluation/life review.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Being(s) described as 'the shepherd' who 'guide and protect'; powerful Presence felt as immense power and love but visually blocked; instruction to tell no one until later, then decades later told to share.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Are you back, already?' / 'No, I am Not, and they don't like to be called that. They are the shepherd.' / 'You may not pass on from this. You must go back and live out your life...' / 'Tell no one of what you have learned here in this place on this day. It is not, yet time,' / 'Now is the time to tell your story, tell your story now.'
